title: Sasquatch Story Studio
logline: In the hidden forest town of Mossy Hollow, an imaginative young Sasquatch named Yeti turns everyday goals into gloriously oversized adventures, then learns how curiosity, honesty, and kindness can help put things right.
creative_promise: A specific comic disaster leads to a sincere character choice; Yeti grows without losing the curiosity and energy that make him Yeti.
episode_structure: imaginative shortcut with an overlooked flaw

non_negotiables.rule: All characters are always barefoot. No shoes, socks, boots, sandals, slippers, skates, cleats, or other footwear may appear.
non_negotiables.prompt_requirement: Every visual generation prompt must positively state bare feet or natural bare paws and explicitly exclude footwear.

non_negotiables.rule: Creator-provided character artwork is authoritative. AI must preserve the established character designs and must not redesign characters.
non_negotiables.prompt_requirement: Resolve manifest-registered, creator-approved character reference images before generation; missing references block generation rather than permitting invention.

non_negotiables.rule: Stories are family friendly and never horror, disturbing, cruel, cynical, or mean-spirited.
Every episode contains a meaningful life lesson expressed through choices and consequences, never a lecture.
Character visual identity, personality, voice, scale, and relationships remain consistent.
Visual action carries story information; dialogue remains natural, concise, and character-specific.
